scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n WEB,EDITOR,UI,MNX,APP,WASM -c green,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta,red "corepack pnpm dev:website" "corepack pnpm dev:editor" "corepack pnpm dev:storybook:ui" "corepack pnpm dev:storybook:mnx" "corepack pnpm dev:storybook" "corepack pnpm wasm:watch"
scripts.preview:prod: corepack pnpm wasm:build && corepack pnpm --filter @viritura/editor preview:prod
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@viritura/editor && pnpm --filter @viritura/desktop build:prebuilt
scripts.build:dotnet: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@viritura/server-ui && pnpm build:dotnet:prebuilt
scripts.build:api-image: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@viritura/server-ui && docker build --file server/Dockerfile.prebuilt --tag viritura-api:local .
scripts.build:vsix: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm turbo run build --filter=mnx-viewer && pnpm turbo run prepare:assets --filter=mnx-viewer && pnpm --filter mnx-viewer package:prebuilt
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:ts && concurrently -n RUST,DOTNET -c yellow,blue "pnpm build:rust" "pnpm build:dotnet:prebuilt"
scripts.test:dotnet: dotnet test server/Viritura.Api.Tests/Viritura.Api.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --nologo && dotnet test server/Viritura.GitHub.Tests/Viritura.GitHub.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --nologo --no-restore
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:dotnet && pnpm build:dotnet:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:rust:wasm && pnpm test:desktop && pnpm test:vst-probe && pnpm test:dotnet && pnpm audit:deps && pnpm wasm:build && pnpm build:site
scripts.lint: pnpm mnx:schema:check && tsx scripts/check-application-boundaries.ts && tsx --test scripts/check-application-boundaries.test.ts && pnpm notationref:test && tsx scripts/check-no-grabbag-filenames.ts && tsx scripts/check-missing-barrels.ts && tsx scripts/check-ui-public-styles.ts && pnpm lint:rust:size && prettier --check . && eslint . && knip --no-config-hints && pnpm --filter @viritura/format gen:raw:check && pnpm --filter @viritura/format gen:raw-viritura:check
scripts.lint:rust: pnpm lint:rust:size && tsx scripts/check-rust-security-apis.ts && cd engine && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cd .. && pnpm gen:raw:rust:check
scripts.lint:rust:fix: cd engine && cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged
scripts.audit:deps: pnpm audit && pnpm audit:dotnet && pnpm audit:rust
scripts.audit:rust: cargo audit --file engine/Cargo.lock --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0192 && cargo audit --file apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock --ignore RUSTSEC-2024-0429 && cargo audit --file tools/vst-reverb-probe/Cargo.lock
scripts.wasm:watch: cd engine && cargo watch -w viritura-engine/src -w viritura-wasm/src -w viritura-engine/Cargo.toml -w viritura-wasm/Cargo.toml -s "corepack pnpm --dir .. wasm:build"
scripts.wasm:profile: cd engine/viritura-wasm && wasm-pack build --profiling --no-opt --target web --out-dir pkg-browser
scripts.mnx:schema:sync: tsx scripts/sync-mnx-schema.ts && pnpm --filter @viritura/format gen:raw && pnpm gen:raw:rust
